prompt: A histogram of home prices in a city has most bars bunched at the lower prices and a long thin tail stretching toward a few very expensive homes. Which word describes the shape?
hint: Skew is named for the direction the TAIL points, not where the pile of data sits.

hints.text: Skew is named for the direction the TAIL points, not where the pile of data sits.
Expensive homes are large numbers, so they sit on the right side of the number line.
The tail stretches to the right, so the distribution is skewed right: choice B.

explanation: Most homes are moderately priced, so the tall bars sit on the left.
A few very expensive homes make a long tail toward the large values on the right.
The tail points right, so the shape is skewed right (choice B).

alternativeExplanations.title: Picture the mean being dragged
steps: Imagine the histogram as a seesaw balanced at the mean.
A few huge prices on the right drag the balance point to the right of the median.
When the mean is pulled right, the tail is on the right: skewed right.
